finding: the reader is composed only when the host supplies DSH_HOME: host/dsh/lib/index.js sets dshHomePath only when process.env.DSH_HOME is defined, and the cluster requires dshHomePath and dshSessionsRoot before it composes a reader

assessment.explicitDshHome: SUPPORTED — the host passes process.env.DSH_HOME through to the install, which derives dshSessionsRoot as join(dshHomePath, 'sessions'); the reader resolves the installed DSH package root under that home
assessment.defaultDshHome: NOT_COMPOSED — with no explicit DSH_HOME the host supplies no dshHomePath, so no reader is composed and the attributed Preview reports the source as unavailable rather than guessing a home path
assessment.productionSpecifier: palimpsest-host-deployment/runtime/session_reader.js is declared in host/deployment/package.json exports and is the composition default; a test process outside the DSH profile overrides it with an absolute path to the SAME file, so there is one reader implementation

evidence.observed: the host sets dshHomePath only when DSH_HOME is defined; the cluster requires dshHomePath and dshSessionsRoot; the default reader specifier is the package export

expectedInvariant: the supported default-home behavior must be source-grounded, and an unverified home path must not be invented merely to satisfy the reader constructor
verdict: PARTIAL — explicit DSH_HOME is verified source-grounded; the supported DEFAULT home resolution is recorded as a limitation rather than guessed
remainingUncertainty: the reader's own resolveDshPackageRoot tries <home>/profiles/node_modules/@deepseek-ai and <home>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai; whether the real first-party host always sets DSH_HOME is a deployment-configuration question this stage does not change
